protocol.ranking_scope: Same-domain same-target known positive versus negative pairs from original verified TRAIN full photos within a minibatch. Unknown labels and TRAIN crops excluded. No new labels, photo source, segmentation truth or inference output.
protocol.ranking_formula: Mean softplus(negative_logit-positive_logit) in each contributing domain-target group, then equal group mean, float32. No pairs yields differentiable zero.
protocol.source_selection: Unchanged core TRAIN manifest, sampler, source/full-crop mass and photo/pixel/auxiliary class weights. ConViD/PECCD/S2DS not added in this experiment.
protocol.epoch_selection: Same existing minimax per-target FNR/FPR on all three source validation domains, then sum of error rates; full-photo grid1 only.
protocol.strict_target: Every crack/spalling source validation FNR and FPR must be strictly below 0.05. The maximum is not the whole-app wrong-photo fraction.
protocol.source_test_policy: Do not infer on test unless the frozen validation strict target is met. Previously inspected source holdouts are not a fresh industrial field guarantee.
protocol.deployment: No automatic app profile/model replacement in this research experiment. A research gate pass alone is insufficient for app deployment.
protocol.interval_policy: Wilson two-sided 95% binomial intervals per observed FNR/FPR; descriptive only. Correlated photos and repeated epoch/threshold selection invalidate an independent confirmatory interpretation.
protocol.stop: Complete this one six-epoch pair; do not automatically retry recipes or extend epochs based on its validation result. No 5% guarantee.
protocol.training_outcome: Not yet measured when this protocol was declared.

spatial_manifest_audit.policy: Only DACL train/new Dam train/CODEBRIM train and their TRAIN detail children; source polygons/masks, negatives from asserted absent classes; CODEBRIM positives have no invented pixel regions; 8x8 any-positive cells; photo labels unchanged
spatial_manifest_audit.scope: Spatial loss supervision, not full-resolution segmentation evaluation or field localization accuracy

matched_pair_conditions.selection: Minimax per-class FNR/FPR in all three validation domains; no pixel accuracy or test used for selection
matched_pair_conditions.loss: Masked weighted focal photo presence + masked focal 8x8-cell source segmentation + .5 positive-class Dice + 0.5 masked original-DACL photo-tag focal
matched_pair_conditions.total_loss_formula: Recorded base photo/pixel/auxiliary loss + target_ranking.weight * within-source full-photo ranking loss

strict_target: Every crack/spalling source FNR/FPR strictly <0.05; not whole-app accuracy
interval_policy: Wilson two-sided 95% descriptive only; independent-photo assumption not validated; repeated validation epoch/cutoff selection and correlated photos prevent confirmatory interpretation
limitations: Single seed and repeated source-validation epoch/threshold selection
Bridge/dam source evidence only; industrial workplace accuracy unmeasured
Source negative means asserted absence of that class, not global facility normal/safe
Ranking groups have equal loss mass; source draw mass unchanged does not mean unchanged loss influence
Research nomination tolerates declared regressions and does not authorize deployment
Unknown source labels retain unknown status; no new classes or truth edits
Only aggregate measurements/hashes published; source images not redistributed
